character: A tall very straight woman, silver hair cut blunt at the jaw, pale grey eyes, a thin white scar round one wrist. Calm, unsmiling, measuring.
wardrobe: A long blue wizard's coat, salt-stained, brass buttons that do not match, reading spectacles on a chain.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing in a ship captain's great cabin with tall stern windows behind her, a wand laid on the desk beside her.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Holding a ring up to the light of tall leaded stern windows in a ship's cabin full of weapons, chests and charts, a customer waiting across the desk.
